verdict.rationale: The published pages say the core online filing flow requires an account first: 'Create a free online account first to file your application,' and myUSCIS is the only online filing path. The Case Status Online tool exists, but no page documents it as a keyless or file-number entry point. That tool is also status tracking, not the filing flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
